build_dpt_image_processor: build a DPTImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images and segmentation maps for DPT depth estimation models
preprocess_dpt_images: preprocess images and optional segmentation maps for DPT model input with resizing, normalization, and label reduction
post_process_semantic_segmentation: post-process semantic segmentation outputs from DPTForSemanticSegmentation into segmentation maps with target size resizing
post_process_depth_estimation: post-process depth estimation outputs from DepthEstimatorOutput into final depth prediction tensors resized to target sizes
reduce_dpt_labels: reduce label values in segmentation maps by 1, replacing 0 with 255 for datasets where background is excluded from classes
